summary.intent: Resolve PR review comments on cipher-box PR #318, refactor the api-client from singleton to instance-scoped axios, investigate a throttle bypass gap in load tests, and clean up test suite naming conventions across the codebase.
summary.outcome: All PR review threads resolved across multiple review rounds; api-client fully refactored to instance-scoped axios eliminating the dual-path singleton architecture; test suites renamed to web-e2e/sdk-e2e/desktop-e2e for consistency; SDK E2E tests merged into main ci.yml workflow; throttle bypass gap confirmed resolved as a side effect of the axios refactor.

repo: The web app uses direct generated API function imports (not CipherBoxClient) for auth, vault init, shares, device approval — these were the last consumers of the singleton pattern.

Phase 19.1 was marked complete in ROADMAP.md but Plan 19.1-05 (rewire web app hooks/stores to SDK) was only partially done — folder/file/bin ops were migrated but auth, shares, IPFS/IPNS direct calls remained.

The BypassableThrottlerGuard.canActivate() returns true before calling super.canActivate(), meaning per-endpoint @Throttle() decorators are always bypassed when the bypass header is present — no gap exists at the NestJS level.
The IPFS controller only uses JwtAuthGuard (no throttle guard), so IPFS operations are not rate-limited by the API layer.
sdk-core's ipfs/index.ts used bare axios.post() with manual token injection instead of the instance-scoped axios, missing 401 refresh capability.
The branch protection rule references job names as 'Release Gate / Verify E2E Passed' — renaming the job in release-gate.yml broke the required check and blocked all PRs from merging.
The sdk-e2e standalone workflow duplicated all CI infrastructure (Postgres, IPFS, Redis services, pnpm install, builds) unnecessarily.
The .planning/ historical docs intentionally preserve old paths/names as point-in-time records and should not be updated during renames.

code.finding: customInstance now accepts optional _axiosInstance in options object, bypassing singleton when provided. createAxiosInstance includes 401 refresh logic. setApiClientConfig accepts a pre-built instance.
SdkContext gains optional axiosInstance field; AxiosInstance type imported from @cipherbox/api-client re-export to avoid direct axios dependency in sdk-core.
createAndPublishIpnsRecord, batchPublishIpnsRecords, resolveIpnsRecord all accept optional ctx parameter to forward the axios instance.
CipherBoxClientConfig gains optional defaultHeaders and axiosInstance fields.
Constructor uses provided axiosInstance or creates its own via createAxiosInstance(); registers it as singleton via setApiClientConfig so direct API calls share the same instance.
Creates the ONE shared axios instance with auth token injection and 401 refresh; passes it to setApiClientConfig; exports it for CipherBoxClient consumption.
New unit test file covering all 7 code paths of BypassableThrottlerGuard; achieved 100% statement/branch/function/line coverage.
Added zeroing of privateKey, rootFolderKey, rootIpnsKeypair.privateKey in destroyClientPool teardown for security. Also added console.warn for write errors instead of silent swallow.
Added try/catch around steps 2-4 of setup with account cleanup rollback on failure.
Job name must remain 'Verify E2E Passed' exactly — branch protection references this string. Internal step names can differ.

workflow: When renaming GitHub Actions job names, always check branch protection required status checks first — the check name is 'WorkflowName / JobName' and must match exactly.
Merging a standalone workflow into ci.yml as a dependent job (needs: test) provides fail-fast behavior and shared pnpm cache without duplicating service container definitions at the job level.
Rate limiting (429) during pnpm test is a transient artifact of parallel test suites hitting the live API simultaneously, not a code bug — a brief cooldown between runs confirms this.

jest.spyOn() mocking prevents coverage instrumentation of the original code; coverage must be verified via jest --coverage with proper collectCoverageFrom config, not by inferring from test pass/fail.
Historical planning docs (.planning/) should be preserved as point-in-time records during renames — only update live code, configs, docs, and workflows.

friction: Renaming the GitHub Actions job name in release-gate.yml broke branch protection and blocked all PRs — discovered only after push, required immediate fix.
Rate limiting (429) from the live API during parallel test runs caused false test failures that required investigation to confirm as transient.
The AxiosInstance type could not be imported directly from 'axios' in sdk/src/types.ts because axios is not a direct dependency — had to use the re-export from @cipherbox/api-client.
jest --coverage CLI invocation with ad-hoc paths did not collect from the right rootDir; required using the package-level jest config to get accurate coverage numbers.
The sdk-core ipns.test.ts mock assertions expected the old single-argument call signature and had to be updated after adding the optional ctx parameter.
The sdk bin/index.ts IPNS calls were missed in the initial threading pass and only caught by a subsequent grep scan.
open_items: The web app still has 13 files importing directly from @cipherbox/api-client for auth, vault setup, shares, device approval, health checks, and IPFS/IPNS — these could eventually be migrated to go through CipherBoxClient to fully eliminate all direct singleton usage.
The setApiClientConfig singleton and getCachedInstance remain in api-client for backward compatibility — can be removed once the web app migration is complete.
The release-please-manifest.json still references tests/web-e2e — should be verified against the actual package path after the rename.
Per-endpoint @Throttle() decorators on IPNS controller (10 publishes/min) may still affect non-bypassed clients in production — the bypass only helps test/SDK clients with the bypass header.
The sdk-e2e and load tests hit a live API (not mocked) — parallel execution causes 429s that require cooldown; consider rate-limit coordination or test isolation improvements.
fetchFromIpfs in sdk-core uses native fetch() for streaming (not the instance-scoped axios) — this path still lacks 401 refresh capability.
